policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. Update measured counts in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances; never lower a floor without an explicit, justified scope change.

tolerance.rationale: Dismissible Smart Refresh notices add a state-watermarked dismissal latch, an additive active-server ShowNotices policy, accessible dual actions, and presentation-only suppression in core/live-update.ts. The legitimate core scope increase is 29 instrumented lines (2637→2666); compatibility, dismissal/retry/re-arm, live suppression, Ask-mode regressions, and download lifecycle regressions raise the reviewed high-water by 30 covered lines (2295→2325, 87.209%). Two clean Node 22.20/V8 full-suite coverage runs on 2026-07-25 each passed all 1560 tests across 223 files and reproduced exactly 2325/2666. Retaining the one-line tolerance makes the minimum 2324/2666 (87.172%), stricter than both the prior 2295/2637 high-water percentage (87.031%) and its 2294/2637 tolerated floor (86.993%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

The completed server-owned ARR lifecycle adds bounded Sonarr/Radarr queue and History collection, deterministic O(q+h) reconciliation, stable persisted instance identity, fail-closed user/library/Seerr authorization, per-member terminal clocks, independent collection reuse, response-end and post-authorization expiry fences, bounded disappearance handoffs, source health, response paging/caps, Manage-status normalization, configuration controls, and policy-aware recursive allowlisted Seerr download-status projection. Privacy and integrity regressions cover exact episodes, convergent provider mappings, hidden authorized pack members, mutable pagination, partial failures, slow fan-out/authorization, and off-page/off-cap stale evidence. This reviewed feature scope adds 415 instrumented lines (30621→31036) and 438 covered lines at the high-water (22077→22515, 72.545%). Three clean .NET 10.0.9/Coverlet runs on 2026-07-25 each passed all 2024 tests and measured 22514, 22514, or 22515 covered lines out of 31036, establishing 22515 as the reviewed high-water. Retaining the evidence-bounded five-line Coverlet tolerance makes the minimum 22510/31036 (72.529%), stricter than both the prior 22077/30621 high-water (72.098%) and its 22072/30621 tolerated floor (72.081%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
